2607.01420.title: MultAttnAttrib: Training-Free Multimodal Attribution in Long Document Question Answering
2607.01420.paper_summary: As grounded QA systems are increasingly deployed in AI assistants, accurately attributing generated answers to evidence is critical for user trust and model safety. While unimodal attributions have been explored in depth, the multimodal setting remains relatively under-researched. As a result, we introduce MultAttnAttrib, a training-free attribution-generation method that leverages a model's prefill pass, selected attention heads, and calibrated thresholds to locate source evidence within a document. To establish baseline results for the method, we introduce MultAttrEval, a complementary benchmark dataset annotated with fine-grained, ground-truth attributions for answer components grounded in multimodal source documents. To our knowledge, this is the first evaluation dataset designed specifically for multimodal attribution in long-form documents. Experimental results show that MultAttnAttrib consistently outperforms a variety of attribution-generation methods, including several strong prompting-based approaches and matches the latest frontier models such as GPT 5.4. Our method not only substantially improves attribution accuracy for both unimodal and multimodal attribution types, but also produces attributions at up to one-seventh of the direct inference latency compared to prompting on the same base model.
2607.01420.paper_summary_zh: 隨著基於證據的 QA 系統越來越多地應用於 AI 助手，準確地將生成的答案歸因於證據對於用戶信任和模型安全至關重要。雖然單模態的歸因已經被深入探討，但多模態的設定仍然相對未被充分研究。因此，我們介紹了 MultAttnAttrib，一種無需訓練的歸因生成方法，利用模型的預填通過、選定的注意力頭和校準的閾值來定位文檔中的源證據。為了為該方法建立基準結果，我們介紹了 MultAttrEval，一個補充的基準數據集，該數據集標註了針對基於多模態源文檔的答案組件的細粒度真實歸因。據我們所知，這是專門為長格式文檔中的多模態歸因設計的第一個評估數據集。實驗結果顯示，MultAttnAttrib 在各種歸因生成方法中始終表現優於，包括幾種強大的基於提示的方法，並且與最新的前沿模型如 GPT 5.4 相匹配。我們的方法不僅顯著提高了單模態和多模態歸因類型的準確性，還在與同一基模型進行提示相比時，將歸因生成的延遲縮短至直接推理延遲的七分之一。
